column1: # manifests/mcp.tsv — MCP servers, installed with each agent's native CLI.
#   name       The server name in every agent's config. Set here, never on the
#              command line: three `codex mcp add copilotkit …` calls with three
#              different URLs left Codex holding only the last one.
#   transport  stdio — target is an npm package run under `npx -y`.
#              http / sse — target is a URL. Codex has no SSE client and POSTs
#              to the URL regardless, so an `sse` row naming it is refused.
#   agents     Native CLI targets. OpenCode reads the shared skill store but
#              needs its own MCP configuration. GitHub Copilot CLI is optional.
